installation.property_evidence_bridge: Only the guarded loader/comment changed; entire default owner and the twenty guarded siblings equal the property-final objects. The eleven calls and header/provider/texture bytes are unchanged.

camera_lifetime_review.safe_output_path: A present camera member with version >= 0x10002 writes both complete matrices and every scalar/vector/table output.
camera_lifetime_review.missing_member_path: A nonzero bundle handle selects the member lookup. Camera start returns sentinel 1; a missing member makes camera read return 1 without writing caller outputs.
camera_lifetime_review.legacy_matrix_path: Version < 0x10002 writes the secondary matrix vectors, then reads its prior flags at 00154e54. The flags and three SDK padding words have no prior caller initialization.
camera_lifetime_review.scope: Control-flow and real output-contract review; does not claim that shipped assets exercise the missing-member or legacy-format cases.
camera_lifetime_review.promotion_requirement: Recover a real caller/asset precondition establishing complete outputs, or the actual defined storage lifetime. A new initialization/lookup/guard changes the measured program and is not exact recovery.
